scope:
New components for the buyer-dependent continuous price system.

Checks only the named calculus/algebra components and one exact nonuniqueness
example. It reuses, without running, the previously checked node recurrence
and double-contact algebra. It does not prove existence or uniqueness of a
price construction from buyer input, or an all-buyer approximation bound.

nonunique_optimal_policy_example.buyers: Z1=Z2=1, each escaping-tail first moment equals 1
nonunique_optimal_policy_example.price_policy_A: mass 1/2 at price 1 and mass 1/2 at price 3
nonunique_optimal_policy_example.price_policy_B: mass 1/2 at price 1 and density 1/4 on (1,3)
nonunique_optimal_policy_example.scope: Exact rational branch formulas for two distinct actual optimal price policies in this one fixed-buyer example. The complete measure interpretation is analytic; fixing a canonical tail convention removes this particular nonuniqueness example only.

reused_without_rerun: fp_ext_k2_buyer_adaptive_prefix_components_20260914: node increments, interval slope decomposition, and double/frozen-contact identities
not_certified: Existence of a price policy from arbitrary buyer input
Optimality of a proposed local maximal-price or minimal-mass selection rule
Uniqueness after imposing a canonical body-price selection
Global KKT multiplier existence or general matching approximation bound
Four-sample numerical replay, owned by a separate script
